bacTrend: Estimated BAC over the last 6 hours
customDrinksEmpty: Save your own drink with a custom size and ingredients.
favoritesVisibilityHint: Turn on the drinks you want to see on your home screen.
favoriteHint: Set caffeine for the reference size below. Quick logging scales it to your selected size.
invalidFavorite: Enter a name, a size from 1–5,000 mL, caffeine from 0–2,000 mg, and strength from 0–100%.
sizeHint: Size stays selected next time you open the app.
favoriteEmpty: Add a favorite to log it with one tap.
quickHint: One tap saves a drink with the selected size.
tagline: A little more mindful, one sip at a time.
deleteBody: Your totals and connected health data will be updated.
goalNote: Non-alcoholic fluids count toward your goal, including coffee and tea. This is intake progress, not a measurement of your hydration.
emptyBody: Log a drink to start seeing your daily totals.
editHint: Tap a drink to edit or delete it.
defaultsNote: Caffeine and strength are estimates. Check the label; caffeine is the total for this drink.
invalidDrink: Enter a valid amount (up to 5 L), caffeine (0–2,000 mg), strength (0–100%), and a date that is not in the future.
readError: Couldn’t load your data. Please reopen the app.
preferencesNote: Choose your units, goal, and favorite serving sizes.
invalidSettings: Check your goal and default size (each 1–5,000 mL). Weight must be 20–400 kg if provided.
bacSetup: Add your weight and a body-water factor in Settings to see an estimate.
bacWarning: Rough estimate only. Absorption, food, medications, and metabolism vary. Never use this to decide whether to drive or whether you are sober, even at 0.000%.
factorNote: Choose the body-water profile used for your estimate. Neither option fits everyone.
backgroundNote: Background sync runs when your operating system allows it. Opening the app also retries pending changes.
healthUnavailable: Health sync needs a native build on a supported iOS or Android device.
healthError: Sync couldn’t finish. Check health permissions and try again. Pending changes are saved.
syncDone: Health data is up to date
disconnectNote: Disconnecting stops future exports. Previously exported records remain in your health app.
localNote: Saved privately on this device. Uninstalling removes your local records.
notFound: This drink is no longer available.
healthApple: Exports non-alcoholic fluids, caffeine, standard drinks (14 g alcohol), and event-time BAC estimates to Apple Health. Reads your latest weight for BAC. Estimates are not sobriety or driving guidance.
healthAndroid: Exports non-alcoholic fluids and caffeine to Health Connect and reads recent weight for BAC. Alcohol and BAC export are not available in this integration.
healthWeight: Health weight used for BAC (manual weight is the fallback)
